name: Losartan + Hydrochlorothiazide
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero
summary: For losartan plus hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ), the US label supports usual regimens while creatinine clearance (CrCl) is above 30 mL/min. Safety and effectiveness below CrCl 30 mL/min have not been established.

bands.recommendation: Usual regimens while CrCl >30 mL/min (label). HCTZ exposure rises 70% (mild) to 700% (moderate impairment).
Safety and effectiveness not established (label). Avoid; use separate agents with specialist input.

hd: Not established (CrCl <30). Losartan is not removed by hemodialysis; HCTZ removal is not established (label).
dialyzable: Losartan: no. Hydrochlorothiazide: degree of removal not established (label).
monitoring: Serum creatinine, potassium, sodium and uric acid; watch for volume depletion.

pediatric.approved_ages: Safety and effectiveness not established in pediatric patients (label).
pediatric.neonates: Neonates with in utero exposure: if oliguria or hypotension, support blood pressure and renal perfusion; exchange transfusion or dialysis may be required (label).
pediatric.egfr_equation: Bedside Schwartz: eGFR (mL/min/1.73 m2) = 0.413 x height (cm) / serum creatinine (mg/dL)

adult: Label (HYZAAR) is CrCl-based; nothing on dialysis dosing.
pediatric: Not established; no extrapolation from single-agent losartan pediatric dosing.
